|game_text='''0 side – Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)'''<br />''Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and A Sith’s Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct.'' '''For''' remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Whenever a character hit by Galen’s Lightsaber or Vader’s Lightsaber leaves table, opponent loses 2 Force. '''While''' this side up, may take Galen’s Fighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Galen’s immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. '''Flip''' this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.<br /><br />'''7 side – Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)'''<br />'''While''' this side up, opponent’s Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any one card without ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin’s Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2. '''Flip''' this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

== History of the oversized sheet ==
'''What it is.''' Alongside the normal set sheet of [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]], the Players Committee made a separate one-page PDF, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/V17-Oversized.pdf V17-Oversized.pdf], headed “The SWCCG Players Committee Presents Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed — Official text as of February 6, 2009”. It holds only this objective: the 0 side, Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V), and the 7 side, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V), each as one large slip under its title.

'''When.''' The PDF was made on 6 February 2009 (13:13, Adobe Illustrator), the date of the set's official text; the full set sheet, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf], was saved two days later, on 8 February 2009. The Committee's home page of 2 March 2009 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20090302100149/http://swccgpc.com/ Internet Archive capture]) carries the news post “5th Anthology and beyond” of 20 February 2009, which says that “The Force Unleashed V set has opened up a whole new degree of V cards with the addition of full card images detailing characters in the Force Unleashed video game”; the full post, the set's release post and the download pages for the two PDFs were not captured by the Internet Archive (searched 12 November 2026: swccgpc.com news posts 46–48, downloads 59–63, and the <code>Resources/virtual/</code> folder), so no Committee statement about the oversized sheet itself survives. Today the Committee lists it as “Virtual Set 17 (Oversized Card)” on its [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips] page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Internet Archive capture of 20 September 2024]).

'''Why.''' The sheet gives no reason beyond its use: it repeats the Committee's usual instructions (“To use these cards, simply print them out and cut out the area beneath the card title (not on the actual card), and place the cutout in a sleeve with the original card. We recommend using opaque sleeves for non-objective cards. If you use clear sleeves, the cutout must be attached to the original card …”). The objective's two sides carry much more text than an ordinary slip, and this sheet prints them at twice the normal slip size.

'''How it differs from the regular slip.''' The words are the same on both sheets (game text above). Each oversized slip is 5.0 × 3.26 inches; on the set sheet each side is a normal slip of 2.48 × 1.43 inches (page 5, slip 17), so the type is about twice as large. The layout of each slip (purple objective frame, italic first sentence, bold “For”, “While” and “Flip”, the 17 / 17 marks) is otherwise the same. Because the printing looks different, this sheet is its own version of the card; the set-sheet slip is [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Set 17) (Errata)]].
